# gramlot-js-server 0.2.13 — Offline container gallery

- Preserve tutorial descriptions in the exported gallery.
- Supply a relative gallery route map to exported example Pages, so carousel thumbnails and delayed live previews work from disk and under a static-host prefix.
- Qualify the updated container gallery against Gramlot 0.3.2 and examples 0.3.4, including retained iframe state and offline navigation.

The Node/Bun adapter, serverless exporter and project scaffolder retain one shared release version. Existing server and Worker responsibilities are unchanged.
